settings.title: Settings
credits.title: Credits
credits.body:
HEX LEGACY
A free fan project by Ben

Design & direction: Ben
Code: Claude (Anthropic)
Art: Higgsfield (Nano Banana Pro, Seedance), Freebeat
Sound effects & hero voices: elevenlabs.io
Music: Made with ElevenMusic
Engine: Phaser
Fonts: Cinzel, Alegreya (SIL Open Font License)

Inspired by Heroes of Might and Magic and Slay the Spire.
Non-commercial. Thanks for playing!
battle.info: {name} ×{count}  ·  HP {top}/{hp}  ·  ATK {atk}  DEF {def}  DMG {dmin}–{dmax}  INI {ini}  SPD {spd}
battle.help: Click a blue hex to move, an enemy to attack. Right-click a stack for details.
passive.lifesteal: Heals 30% of damage dealt, can revive
heroSelect.title: Choose your hero
heroSelect.more: Elves, Dwarves, Undead, Orcs and Demons will follow.
node.upgradeHint: +12% HP and damage, +1 ATK and DEF
map.hint: Click a glowing node to travel there. Scroll with the mouse wheel or by dragging.
shop.text: "Welcome, commander! Training, recruits, steel – everything has its price."
shop.atkHint: Your hero's attack counts for every unit.
shop.defHint: Your hero's defense counts for every unit.
shop.upgradeHint: +12% HP and damage, +1 ATK and DEF for one unit type.
shop.unitHint: Adds a new unit type to your army.
shop.unitFull: Your army already has 3 unit types.
rest.text: The camp fire crackles. Your troops can rest – or train through the night.
rest.upgradeHint: One unit type gains an upgrade level for free.
rest.upgraded: Your {unit} trained hard and gained a level.
rest.drilled: New volunteers join the camp. +{n} leadership.
treasure.text: Among the ruins you find a chest with {gold} gold.
shrine.text: An old shrine hums with power. The gods ask for an offering.
shrine.blessed: Light falls upon your army. +1 ATK, +1 DEF.
shrine.sworn: Your soldiers swear to fight to the last. +3 ATK, −15 leadership.
event.wounded_soldier.title: The wounded soldier
event.wounded_soldier.text: A wounded soldier lies by the road. His unit was scattered, but his eyes still burn with fighting spirit.
event.wounded_soldier.helped: Healed and grateful, he leads you to a group of other survivors. +15 leadership.
event.wounded_soldier.robbed: Your troops watch silently. Morale drops. +30 gold, −1 DEF.
event.wishing_well.title: The wishing well
event.wishing_well.text: An old well, its stones covered in moss. Coins glitter at the bottom.
event.wishing_well.wish: The water glows. Your wish is granted: {boon}.
event.bandit_ambush.title: Ambush!
event.bandit_ambush.text: Bandits block the road. "Your gold or your life!"
event.bandit_ambush.paid: The bandits laugh and let you pass.
event.cave_treasure.title: The cave
event.cave_treasure.text: Gold glimmers deep inside a cave. But something big breathes in the dark.
event.cave_treasure.entered: Eyes light up in the dark …
event.mercenary_camp.title: Mercenary camp
event.mercenary_camp.text: Mercenaries sit around their fires, offering their services.
event.mercenary_camp.hired: The mercenaries join your army. +25 leadership.
event.forest_shrine.title: Forest shrine
event.forest_shrine.text: A shrine of the old gods, covered in offerings.
event.forest_shrine.prayed: A calm warmth fills your soldiers. +1 DEF.
event.forest_shrine.taken: Some soldiers refuse to follow a temple robber. +70 gold, −10 leadership.
event.knight_tournament.title: Knight tournament
event.knight_tournament.text: A tournament in the next village! The winner gets a purse of gold.
event.knight_tournament.joinHint: Chance grows with your ATK; prize 90 gold
event.knight_tournament.lost: Your champion falls from the horse. The crowd laughs.
event.dormant_forge.title: The dormant forge
event.dormant_forge.text: An abandoned dwarven forge. The anvil is still warm.
event.dormant_forge.workHint: A random unit type gains an upgrade level
reward.title: Victory!
reward.draftHint: Pick one unit type for your army – or skip.
reward.draftFull: Your army has 3 unit types: a new one replaces an old one.
reward.replaceHint: The replaced unit type and its upgrades are lost.
runEnd.wonText: The Bandit King has fallen! This is where the prototype ends – acts 2 and 3 follow.
runEnd.lostText: Your army fell on floor {floor}. But every run makes you wiser.
passive.antiMounted: Takes 40% less damage from mounted units
passive.poisonHit: Hits poison the target for 2 turns
passive.curseHit: Hits lower the target's ATK by 2 for 2 turns
passive.corrode: Hits lower the target's DEF by 2 for 2 turns
passive.regen: The wounded creature heals fully every turn
passive.fearAura: Adjacent enemies may freeze in fear (25%)
ability.spearWall.name: Spear Wall
ability.spearWall.desc: Until its next turn, every melee attacker first takes a counter strike (50% damage).
ability.aimedShot.name: Aimed Shot
ability.aimedShot.desc: A shot with +50% damage that ignores a defending stance.
ability.shieldFormation.name: Shield Formation
ability.shieldFormation.desc: +4 DEF for itself and all adjacent allies for 2 turns.
ability.revival.name: Revival
ability.revival.desc: Heals an allied stack by 20 HP per cleric and brings fallen soldiers back.
ability.dive.name: Dive
ability.dive.desc: Swoops onto an enemy in range, attacks and flies back to its starting hex.
ability.holyStrike.name: Holy Strike
ability.holyStrike.desc: Hits all adjacent enemies (75% damage) and heals adjacent allies.
ability.boneSwarm.name: Bone Swarm
ability.boneSwarm.desc: Summons half as many skeletons next to it for 2 rounds. Once per battle.
ability.rotStench.name: Rotten Stench
ability.rotStench.desc: All adjacent enemies lose 3 ATK for 2 turns.
ability.disembody.name: Disembody
ability.disembody.desc: Cannot be attacked until its next turn.
ability.bloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
ability.bloodFrenzy.desc: Teleports next to any enemy and attacks it.
ability.deathWave.name: Wave of Death
ability.deathWave.desc: Hits the target (80%) and all living enemies next to it (60%). Undead are spared.
ability.decayBreath.name: Breath of Decay
ability.decayBreath.desc: Breathes on an adjacent enemy and the enemy standing behind it.
info.title: Unit details
city.title: The City
city.firstVisit: Bring resources home from your runs and build here!
city.districtLocked: This quarter opens when its people become playable.
building.townHall.name: Town Hall
building.townHall.desc: The heart of the city. Each level raises the start gold and lets all other buildings grow one level higher.
building.townHall.l1: +25 start gold, other buildings up to level 2
building.barracks.name: Barracks
building.barracks.desc: More soldiers answer your call: more leadership at the start of every run.
building.trainingYard.name: Training Yard
building.smithy.name: Smithy
building.smithy.l1: Your first start unit type begins with ★
building.smithy.l2: Both start unit types begin with ★
building.marketplace.name: Marketplace
building.marketplace.desc: Trade contacts make the travelling merchants cheaper.
building.tavern.name: Tavern
building.tavern.desc: Famous heroes gather here and want to join you.
building.academy.name: Academy
building.academy.desc: Scholars teach your heroes new ways.
building.academy.l1: 4 choices at every level-up instead of 3
building.warehouse.name: Warehouse
building.warehouse.desc: Safe storage for the spoils of war.
building.warehouse.l1: Keep 85% instead of 60% of the resources after a defeat
building.fieldCamp.name: Field Camp
building.fieldCamp.desc: Experienced quartermasters make camps on the road more useful.
building.fieldCamp.l2: Mustering at a camp gives +20 instead of +12 leadership
building.cathedral.name: Cathedral
building.cathedral.desc: Priests of the Light join the army.
building.griffinAerie.name: Griffin Aerie
building.knightsHall.name: Knights' Hall
building.knightsHall.desc: The holy order of the Paladins.
